purpose: MonIA is not an episode player. It is a continuous-life drama director that can temporarily turn gameplay into a high-impact cinematic, visio, call or micro-drama beat, then return naturally to free play.

ambient.goal: make the world feel alive without interrupting play

micro_reaction.goal: show a readable human reaction or relationship beat

visio.goal: feel like a real spontaneous phone video call

cinematic.goal: external cinematic coverage for an emotionally important beat

drama_sequence.goal: compose multiple short shots or media beats around one meaningful event

offer_choice_when: player can choose approach or response
the moment would feel artificial if MonIA decided Marion's action

pacing.cliffhanger_rule: Use a hook or unresolved beat only when the event naturally supports one. Do not manufacture danger or misunderstanding to imitate short-drama apps.

carry_forward: wardrobe if the scene is continuous
continuity.scene_to_scene_visual_rule: When consecutive generated shots represent one continuous event, MonIA should preserve spatial, wardrobe, lighting and emotional continuity.

quality_gates: scene has a readable dramatic beat
transition back to gameplay is defined
